daily_quests.title: ASX 200 Momentum Rank — Window Functions Challenge
daily_quests.description: Using ASX 200 historical price data, calculate a 30-day rolling average price for each stock ticker. Then use ROW_NUMBER() and RANK() window functions to rank stocks by their momentum (current price vs rolling average) within each date partition. Find the top 5 momentum gainers for the most recent date in your dataset. Expected output: ticker, date, closing_price, 30day_avg, momentum_rank, momentum_percentile.

daily_quests.title: NSW Road Crash Data Cleaning Pipeline
daily_quests.description: Download NSW Road Crash Data (contains crash records with location, severity, vehicle type, weather conditions). Write a Python/pandas script to: (1) handle missing values in severity and weather columns (impute or drop strategically), (2) standardise vehicle type categories (consolidate similar types), (3) extract crash hour from datetime, (4) create a severity score (1-5 scale), (5) export cleaned data to CSV. Document your cleaning decisions in comments. Expected output: a clean CSV with 10+ columns ready for analysis.

daily_quests.title: Australian Wildfire Risk Analysis — Python ETL + SQL Analytics
daily_quests.description: Part A (Python): Download Australian Wildfire dataset (Kaggle). Use pandas to clean and standardise location data (latitude/longitude), date fields, and fire size/severity columns. Create a CSV with enriched data: fire_id, state, region, date, size_hectares, severity_level, season (derived from date). Part B (SQL): Load your cleaned CSV into a database. Write a query using CTEs to: (1) calculate fire frequency by state and season, (2) find the top 3 states with largest average fire size, (3) rank seasons by total fires using ROW_NUMBER(). Join results to show correlation between season and severity. Expected output: a report showing seasonal wildfire patterns by state with rankings.
